metadata.title: Equipment Shop
metadata.description: A 60 x 100 equipment shop near Redstone, Texas, with roof and wall panels cut to length in our shop and delivered with trim, closures, and fasteners on one load.

metadata.title: Ranch Shop
metadata.description: A three-purpose ranch shop west of Redstone, Texas, specified from a sketch and built with heavier-gauge wall panels, matched trim, and fasteners from our floor.

metadata.title: Commercial Building
metadata.description: A two-tone commercial metal building in Redstone, Texas with a standing seam roof, a full-length accent band run from one coil batch, and custom entry-canopy trim.

metadata.title: Metal Roof Installation
metadata.description: A hail-damage re-roof in Redstone, Texas turned around in a week with full-length roofing panels and rake and eave trim formed to the existing roof conditions.

metadata.title: Pole Barn
metadata.description: A phased post-frame pole barn near Redstone, Texas — roof and three walls first, with the remaining walls and enclosed bays specified to match the same color run.
